## Professional Summary

Market research and analytics professional with 4+ years of experience in market sizing, forecasting, competitive intelligence, consumer insights, and syndicated research across retail and consumer sectors.

My background combines market research, economics, and business analytics, with experience translating complex market and consumer data into actionable business insights. I am currently expanding this foundation through graduate study and hands-on work in Python, SQL, business intelligence, data visualization, machine learning, and cloud analytics.

## Professional Experience

### Senior Analyst | GlobalData PLC
**Hyderabad, India | Oct 2018 – Mar 2022**

Led quantitative and qualitative market research across retail and consumer sectors, developing market intelligence and strategic insights for global clients.

My work included market sizing and multi-year forecasting, competitive intelligence, company benchmarking, primary and secondary research, expert interviews, questionnaire design, and market opportunity analysis. I also contributed to syndicated research and translated complex market findings into client-ready insights and recommendations.

My research and analyst commentary were cited by international publications including **Quartz, LiveMint, Business of Fashion, Just Style, Yahoo News, and Retail Asia**.


### Research Associate | Global Market Estimates
**Pune, India | Sep 2017 – Oct 2018**

Conducted primary and secondary research across consumer markets, supporting the development of syndicated market research reports and client-focused analyses.

My work included market and competitor research, survey questionnaire design, data analysis, market estimation, and the development of analytical models and research deliverables. I synthesized findings from multiple sources to identify market trends, growth opportunities, and competitive developments.
